CommunityApplications.Profile:
unraid-plugins is a collection of unRAID plugins and Docker apps. Currently published:
- unraid-unzip: right-click archive extraction for the built-in unRAID File Manager. Extracts 7z, zip, RAR, tar, and the compressed tarballs (.tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.bz2, .tar.xz, .tar.zst) to a destination you choose, with saved passwords, exclude patterns, an overwrite policy, and background jobs.
- songs-download: YouTube music search, audio preview and download to a local music folder. Runs as a Docker container (port 8765).
- amazon-mcp: MCP server (streamable HTTP on port 8000) for product search on amazon.de. Wraps the upstream image ghcr.io/jnslmk/amazon-mcp.
More entries may be added over time; plugins are listed in plugins/, Docker apps in templates/, and all are documented in the README.
Maintained by h4de5. Report issues in the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/h4de5/unraid-plugins/issues).
